#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>

int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
    while (t % n != 0) {
        int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * (int)(t % n);
        s = (s + n + delta) % n;
        t--;
    }
    t /= n;

    std::vector<long long> when(n, -1);

    for (long long left = t; left > 0; left--) {
        if (when[s] != -1) {
            long long period = when[s] - left;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (when[i] != -1 && when[i] <= when[s] && when[i] % period == 0) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
            assert(false);
        }
        when[s] = left;
        for (int step = n - 1; step > 0; step--) {
            if (s < k) {
                s += step;
                if (s >= n) s -= n;
            } else {
                s -= step;
                if (s < 0) s += n;
            }
        }
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    int n, k, s;
    long long t;
    scanf("%d%d%d%lld", &n, &k, &s, &t);
    s--; // subtract 1 as in Java code
    printf("%d\n", solve(n, k, s, t) + 1);
    return 0;
}
